ja: • 山手線開業130周年を記念したYamanote Historyシリーズ。
• 1957年に登場した国鉄の通勤型電車。中央線用にオレンジの塗装色で登場し、その後山手線用にカナリヤ色を投入。
• 1963年に103系が山手線に投入されると、101系は総武線に順次転属した。
• 先頭車（前面２種、屋根２種：パンタ付き／パンタなし）＋中間車（屋根３種：パンタ付き／パンタなし／パンタ台）の２両セット。
• NEW SGフレーム、ステッカー付属。
en: • Yamanote History series commemorating the 130th anniversary of the opening of the Yamanote Line.
• A JNR commuter train introduced in 1957. It appeared in an orange paint color for the Chuo Line, and then a canary color was introduced for the Yamanote Line.
• When the 103 series was introduced to the Yamanote Line in 1963, the 101 series was transferred to the Sobu Line.
• A 2-car set consisting of the lead car (2 front types, 2 roof types: with pantos/no pantos) + the middle car (3 roof types: with pantos/without pantos/panda stand).
• NEW SG frame and sticker included.
